    - article:
      - heading "💡 WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal:"
      - paragraph:
        - img
        - text: Corresponding angles occupy the same relative position.
      - paragraph:
        - img
        - text: Their measures are equal.
      - paragraph: "Converse also true:"
      - paragraph:
        - img
        - text: If corresponding angles are equal, then the lines are parallel.
      - button "⌁ View Formula"
    - article:
      - heading "▣ WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - heading "If ∠1 = 64°, what is ∠5?" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Since ∠1 and ∠5 are corresponding angles,
      - strong: ∠1 = ∠5
      - paragraph: Therefore, ∠5 = 64°.
      - img: 1 5
    - article:
      - heading "△ COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=2]
      - heading "Angles on the same side of the transversal are not automatically corresponding." [level=3]
      - paragraph: Position matters!
      - img: 1 3 ×
      - paragraph: ∠1 and ∠3 are on the same side but are not corresponding angles.
